qualification: TRANSITIVE_REFERENCE_SUFFICIENCY_APPLIES_TO_DIRECT_FIELD_REPETITION__NOT_TO_OMISSION_OF_INTERPRETATION_CRITICAL_CLOSURE_MATERIAL. Required semantic/authority material must be packaged or exactly immutable-addressable under a hash-bound resolution contract.

r02_holding: ReplayReceipt is audit/replay-only and is not a runtime prior
qualification: No semantic qualification. Integrity verification may block a corrupt/unverifiable object, but receipt metadata may not rank, weight, select, authorize, compose sources or alter actor development.
required_close_read_obligation: All stage contracts must keep ReplayReceipt in replay/audit provenance and prohibit resolver ranking, V554/V555/V556 semantic use, source weighting and V3 probability use.

r02_holding: EmpiricalUniverse is transitively dereferenceable downstream after the producer basis
qualification: Universe identity must be exact and immutable; a source label or harmonized alias is insufficient. Any cross-universe semantic equivalence, respondent linkage or pooling relation needed by a claim must also be exactly closed under its own authority.
required_close_read_obligation: V553/V554 and V557/V558 close-reads must identify universe/source-relation refs as interpretation-critical where applicable; add same-label conflicting-universe and no-linkage fixtures.

r02_holding: EmpiricalQuerySpec is transitively dereferenceable after admission
qualification: Exact query identity means the governed target, predicate AST, universe/scope, risk set, topology, measure and authority identity remain recoverable. A query ID pointing to mutable current/latest material is not sufficient.
required_close_read_obligation: Reference contracts must expose exact QuerySpec ID/hash and immutable material/resolution contract for every admission whose structural interpretation depends on that empirical fact.
nonsemantic_boundary: Query provenance does not authorize downstream query reinterpretation.

r02_holding: Weight/measure basis is empirical authority and may remain transitive in later structural stages
qualification: Replay must recover the selected estimand, exact weight basis/status/design authority, raw support and governed uncertainty/typed absence. Displayed percentages or copied scalar weights are not substitutes.
required_close_read_obligation: Run the measure/risk-set recovery fixture after stripping all convenience fields; equal denominators with different member sets and equal displayed masses under different designs must fail equivalence.
nonsemantic_boundary: Measure provenance may inform exact admission validation only under existing authority; it is not a later-stage prior weight.

r02_holding: AuthoritySnapshot is preserved by reference and later authority versions do not silently reinterpret historical outputs
qualification: Reference sufficiency requires authority_id + version + content hash + immutable content or exact immutable resolution contract. Name-only/latest/current lookup is forbidden.
required_close_read_obligation: Historical replay fixture must replay an object under its original authority after a conflicting newer authority exists; missing historical authority fails closed while preserving the unknown.
nonsemantic_boundary: Authority provenance governs interpretation of the historical transformation; it does not itself create a new runtime prior.
